note: spring5-security-batch: sun.misc.BASE64* in TokenCodec.java → java.util.Base64, the same script as java6-legacy; its case is resolved (improved), javac then reports the try / catch (IOException) around the port as a new case of the same file — L2 `compile|cannot_find_symbol|BASE64Encoder` (26271fddc9) / `compile|cannot_find_symbol|BASE64Decoder` (cb9cae8eb7)
response:
<analysis>sun.misc.BASE64Encoder / BASE64Decoder are JDK internals that javac 21 (--release 21) no longer exposes (jdk-removed-apis). The script ports every call in the case's files to java.util.Base64: `new BASE64Encoder().encode(x)` → `Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(x)`, `new BASE64Decoder().decodeBuffer(x)` → `Base64.getMimeDecoder().decode(x)` (line-break tolerant like the old decoder), and swaps the imports; public signatures stay.</analysis>
<script>
import re

SUN_IMPORT = re.compile(r"^import\s+sun\.misc\.BASE64(?:En|De)coder;\n", re.M)


def fix(p):
    done = set()
    for e in p.errors:
        path = e.get("file")
        if not path or path in done or not p.exists(path):
            continue
        done.add(path)
        text = p.read(path)
        new = re.sub(r"new\s+BASE64Encoder\(\)\.encode\(", "Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(", text)
        new = re.sub(r"new\s+BASE64Decoder\(\)\.decodeBuffer\(", "Base64.getMimeDecoder().decode(", new)
        if re.search(r"\bBASE64(?:En|De)coder\b", SUN_IMPORT.sub("", new)):
            p.log(f"{path}: other sun.misc.BASE64 usages left - not changed")
            continue
        if "import java.util.Base64;" not in new:
            new = SUN_IMPORT.sub("import java.util.Base64;\n", new, count=1)
        new = SUN_IMPORT.sub("", new)
        if new != text:
            p.write(path, new)
            p.log(f"{path}: sun.misc.BASE64Encoder/Decoder -> java.util.Base64")
        else:
            p.log(f"{path}: nothing to change")
</script>
